title: Digi Yatra goes international
dek: Face-based airport entry and boarding, already used at 39 domestic airports, is now on trial for overseas departures.
seoTitle: Digi Yatra international flights 2026: trial airports, who can use it, timeline
bigLabel: Running face-based boarding trials for international flights

glance.what: Since 1 November 2026, Indian e-passport holders on select Air India and IndiGo international flights can use Digi Yatra at seven airports.
glance.why: It could make international departures quicker, but it does not replace passport, airline or immigration checks.
glance.next: The trial runs until December 2026. Feedback will shape a wider rollout in 2027.

forYou: To try it you need an Indian e-passport, the Digi Yatra app and a select Air India or IndiGo international flight from Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi, Mumbai, Chennai or Amritsar. Carry your documents as usual.
next: Trial runs to December; wider rollout planned for 2027.

events.title: Contactless international trial with IATA in Bengaluru
events.summary: IndiGo, Digi Yatra, Bengaluru airport and IATA complete technical trials of an integrated contactless international travel project.

events.title: Passes 100 million journeys
events.summary: An IATA-led trial shows Digi Yatra can work with global systems and with Apple and Google wallets.

events.title: International trials announced
events.summary: Plans are set for trials at major airports between October and December 2026.

events.title: International trials begin at seven airports
events.summary: Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi, Mumbai, Chennai and Amritsar start trials for Indian e-passport holders on select Air India and IndiGo flights.
